name: W72 matched nulls
principle: Report exact conditional nulls; do not assign significance to structural theorems forced by the frozen Z6 phase coordinate.

tests.statistic: existence of group isomorphism C6 ≅ C3×C2
tests.interpretation: Not a statistical surprise; it is forced by CRT because 2 and 3 are coprime.

tests.statistic: a uniformly random bijection of 6 labeled phases to 6 labeled (tau,beta) pairs is a group isomorphism
tests.interpretation: Describes a pre-specified coordinate labeling test only. It is NOT the p-value for discovering an isomorphism after searching mappings.

tests.statistic: same as NULL-02 conditional on identity mapped to identity
random nonidentity translation of C6 has order2
tests.interpretation: B=+3 is the unique nontrivial order-2 translation.

tests.statistic: pre-specified perfect matching on six phase states equals B pairing
tests.interpretation: Only meaningful if the matching is specified independently. Any search for some perfect matching makes the event trivial.
